title: The Burning & the Bound: Grievous Ghost Tour of Atlanta
includes: Intensely researched true stories of history
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a spine-chilling journey through the eerie streets of Atlanta on our captivating walking ghost tour, where history and hauntings intertwine. Led by a knowledgeable local guide, this tour takes you to some of Midtown’s most haunted and historic locations. As you explore the shadows of iconic buildings, you'll hear tales of ghostly encounters and lingering spirits. From the terminus of Georgia’s railway system to the heart of the city, uncover the unsettling truths that have shaped Atlanta's haunted legacy.

During this mile-long trek, you'll visit notorious sites like Babs Midtown, Siva’s Hookah Lounge, Piedmont Avenue Health and Fitness, and the Goodwill Donation Center, all steeped in ghostly lore. While we won’t enter privately owned buildings, you'll stand on haunted ground surrounded by echoes of the past. Perfect for history buffs and thrill-seekers alike, this tour promises a night of ghostly revelations and unforgettable experiences in the heart of Atlanta!
